proposed_judgements.unjudged_documents: All other corpus chunks are UNJUDGED, not presumed irrelevant

evaluation_conventions.graded_relevance_scale: 0 irrelevant, 1 marginal, 2 useful partial, 3 directly sufficient; current proposal includes only 2 and 3
evaluation_conventions.idcg: Compute from all reviewed qrels per query, NOT only retrieved top-K
evaluation_conventions.warning: Qrels are incomplete / unreviewed. Do not publish Recall@K or NDCG@K as unbiased, definitive search-quality metrics.

caveats: Some lecture PDFs appear to be near-duplicate slide variants; all versions remain in this corpus and require pooled relevance judgement.
PDF text extraction degrades some mathematical expressions; review source page to confirm query answerability.
Proposed positive qrels cover verified-looking source-page candidates, not an exhaustive judgement pool.
Public branch contains queries, document identifiers and source/page pointers, not full course PDFs or chunk text.
